changelog: Reinstall-aware agent on top of the 1.77.37 CI-recovery baseline: --re-cert flag + C:\ProgramData\Sentinel\.re-cert-pending marker handling. On startup with the marker present (written by the InnoSetup installer when re-installing on an enrolled machine), the agent decrypts its existing config, presents its current mTLS client cert to POST /api/agent/re-cert, atomically rotates client.crt/client.key/ca-cert.pem with timestamped .bak backups (last 3 retained), deletes the marker, then enters the normal heartbeat loop with the fresh cert. Identity (agent_id, device history) preserved across reinstalls. New internal/recert package with full test coverage. Server endpoint and installer marker writing land in companion branches fix/recert-server and fix/recert-installer.
